title: Loan readiness
subtitle: Your checked books, ready to show a lender. Kredibel tells you what to fix first.
notCredit: Your own check of your books, computed by code from the documents you uploaded. It is not a credit decision: the lender decides.

headline.READY: Your books are checked and ready to show a lender.
headline.ALMOST_READY_one: Settle {{count}} thing before you show a lender.
headline.ALMOST_READY_other: Settle {{count}} things before you show a lender.
headline.NOT_READY_one: Fix {{count}} thing before you show a lender.
headline.NOT_READY_other: Fix {{count}} things before you show a lender.

HISTORY.title: Months of bank statements
HISTORY.PASS_one: {{count}} month of statements, read and checked.
HISTORY.PASS_other: {{count}} months of statements, read and checked.
HISTORY.WARN_one: {{count}} month of statements. Lenders often ask for {{threshold}}: upload more.
HISTORY.WARN_other: {{count}} months of statements. Lenders often ask for {{threshold}}: upload more.
HISTORY.FAIL_one: Only {{count}} month of statements. Upload at least {{threshold}}.
HISTORY.FAIL_other: Only {{count}} months of statements. Upload at least {{threshold}}.

COVERAGE.title: Every month covered
COVERAGE.PASS: Every account has a statement for every month.
COVERAGE.WARN_one: The balance does not carry over between {{count}} pair of statements. Check that none is missing.
COVERAGE.WARN_other: The balance does not carry over between {{count}} pairs of statements. Check that none is missing.
COVERAGE.FAIL: A statement is missing for {{months}}. Upload it.

RECONCILED.title: Months reconciled
RECONCILED.PASS: Every month is reconciled, with at least {{threshold}} of bank lines matched by Kredibel.
RECONCILED.WARN: {{months}}: not reconciled yet, or under {{threshold}} matched. Settle the bank lines Kredibel could not match.

FINDINGS.title: No open risks
FINDINGS.PASS: No critical or high risk is open.
FINDINGS.WARN_one: {{count}} high risk is open. Explain or resolve it first.
FINDINGS.WARN_other: {{count}} high risks are open. Explain or resolve them first.
FINDINGS.FAIL_one: {{count}} serious risk is open. Fix it before anyone relies on these books.
FINDINGS.FAIL_other: {{count}} serious risks are open. Fix them before anyone relies on these books.

REVIEW.title: Decisions taken
REVIEW.PASS: Nothing waits in the review queue: every figure is final.
REVIEW.WARN_one: {{count}} decision waits in the review queue.
REVIEW.WARN_other: {{count}} decisions wait in the review queue.

CASH.title: Cash flow
CASH.PASS: More money came in than went out, and the balance never went below zero.
CASH.WARN_net: More money went out than came in. Be ready to explain why.
CASH.WARN_days_one: The balance went below zero on {{count}} day, in {{months}}. Be ready to explain it.
CASH.WARN_days_other: The balance went below zero on {{count}} days, in {{months}}. Be ready to explain it.

figures.matchedNote: Bank lines matched to an invoice, receipt or the ledger

explainedNote: Written by Gemini from the month's findings and checked against them; every figure comes from code.
clientsNote: Share of the period's money in

empty.title: Nothing to show a lender yet
empty.body: Upload your bank statements. Once Kredibel has read and reconciled them, this page shows whether your books are ready.
